t: In the given figure, ∆ABC is right angled at B. If AB = (X + 4) cm, BC = X/2 cm, AC = (X + 6) cm and the length of inradius of ∆ABC is 4 cm, then find the value of X.
e:
Given inradius (r) = 4 cm
Area of ∆ABC = 1/2 * (X/2) * (X + 4) = (X/4) * (X + 4) sq. cm
Semi-perimeter of ∆ABC = (X + 4 + X + 6 + (X/2))/2 = (5X + 20)/4 cm
We know that,
Inradius = Area/semi-perimeter
4 = (X<sup>2</sup> + 4X)/(5X + 20)
20X + 80 = X<sup>2</sup> + 4X
X<sup>2</sup> - 16X - 80 = 0
X<sup>2</sup> - 20X + 4X - 80 = 0
X(X - 20) + 4(X - 20) = 0
(X - 20)(X + 4) = 0
X = 20.
Alternative solution:
In right angled triangle,
Inradius = (Perpendicular + Base - Hypotenuse)/2
4 * 2 = X + 4 + X/2 - (X + 6)
16 = 2X + 8 + X - 2X - 12
X = 20

Shortcut Method:
As, ∆ABC is right angled triangle.
So, By pythagoras theorem,
(x + 4)<sup>2</sup> + (x/2)<sup>2</sup> = (x + 6)<sup>2</sup>
x<sup>2</sup> + 16 + 8x + x<sup>2</sup>/4 = x<sup>2</sup> + 36 + 12x
x<sup>2</sup>/4 - 4x- 20 = 0
x<sup>2</sup> - 16 - 80 = 0
(x -20)(x + 4) = 0
so, x = 20

t: In a triangle, the lengths of sides are 6 units, 12 units and x units. How many possible integer values are there for x?
e:
Triangle Inequality Theorem: The sum of the lengths of any two sides of a triangle must be greater than the length of the third side.
Using the Triangle Inequality Theorem:
6 + 12 > x
6 + x > 12
12 + x > 6
From the first inequality:
x < 18
From the second inequality:
x > 6
From the third inequality:

Combining the inequalities:

Possible integer values for x :

Number of possible integer values : 11

t: In ΔPQR, if PT is the median, then which of the following is correct?
e:
In any triangle, the following relationship holds when a median is drawn from a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side:
PQ² + PR² = 2(PT² + QT²)
This formula is derived from the median theorem, which states that the sum of the squares of the two sides of a triangle (PQ and PR) is equal to twice the sum of the square of the median (PT) and the square of half the base (QT), i.e., the length of the segment from P to the midpoint of QR.
The correct answer is: PQ² + PR² = 2(PT² + QT²)

t: The three sides of two triangles are 4, 5 and 6 cm. Select the INCORRECT statement.
o: The angle opposite to the greater side in those triangles will be greater.
The area of the two triangles will be different.
The two triangles are scalene triangles.
e:
The three sides of two triangles are given as 4 cm, 5 cm and 6 cm which means all the sides of both the triangles are equal. So, both the triangles are congruent.
In any triangle, angle opposite to the greater side is greater and angle opposite to the smaller side is smaller.
Area of two congruent triangles is always the same.
Since all the sides of the triangle are different, hence the triangle is called scalene triangle.
Hence, the statement given in option (b) is incorrect.

t: The ratio between the angles of a quadrilateral is 7:5:2:6. If the difference between the largest and smallest angle of the quadrilateral is 25% more than one of the angles of a parallelogram, then what can be inferred about the largest angle of the parallelogram?

Hence, 7x + 5x + 2x + 6x = 360
or 20x = 360
or x = 18 degrees.
Hence the angles are 126, 90, 36 and 108 degrees respectively.
Difference between the largest and smallest angle = 90 degrees.
Now that is 25% more than one of the angles of a parallelogram.
Thus one of the angles of a parallelogram is 72 degrees, and it's adjacent angle is 108 degrees.

t: A circle is entirely enclosed within a parallelogram such that all four sides of the parallelogram are tangent to the circle. What particular type of parallelogram must this be?
e: A circle can be inscribed within a parallelogram (meaning it is tangent to all four sides) only if the parallelogram is a tangential quadrilateral. In tangential quadrilateral, sum of opposite sides are equal. AB+CD= BC +DA CAB=CD and BC=DA opposite side of parallelogram are equal 2 (AB)=2(BC) ⇒ AB = BC Thus, a parallelogram with adjacent sides equal is a Rhombus.
h: एक वृत्त पूरी तरह से एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के भीतर इस प्रकार घिरा हुआ है कि समांतर चतुर्भुज की चारों भुजाएँ वृत्त को स्पर्श करती हैं। यह समांतर चतुर्भुज किस विशेष प्रकार का होना चाहिए?

t: Find the perimeter of major sector of a circle of radius 12 meters, whose minor sector subtends an angle of 75° at the center.

Arc length of any sector of a circle which makes angle of θ at the centre = 2πr * (θ/360)
Total perimeter of the sector = Arc length + 2 * Radius = 2πr * (θ/360) + 2r
Since minor sector makes an angle of 75° at the centre which means major sector will make angle equal to 360° - 75° = 285°
So, perimeter of major sector = 2π * 12 * (285/360) + 2 * 12
= 19π + 24 meters

t: The distance between the centers of two circles is d. The lengths of their direct and transverse common tangents are L and M, respectively. If L²+M²=200 and the sum of the squares of their radii is 100, what is the value of d?
e:
Formula Used
Direct common tangent (L):
L² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² ---(i)
Transverse common tangent (M):
M² = d² - (r₁ + r₂)² ---(ii)
Adding equations (i) and (ii):
L² + M² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² + d² - (r₁ + r₂)²
= 2d² - [r₁² - 2r₁r₂ + r₂² + r₁² + 2r₁r₂ + r₂²]
= 2d² - 2(r₁² + r₂²)
Given: L² + M² = 200, r₁² + r₂² = 100
200 = 2d² - 2×100
d² = 200
d = √200 = 10√2
h: दो वृत्तों के केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी d है। उनकी सीधी और अनुप्रस्थ उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाई क्रमशः L और M है। यदि L²+M²=200 और उनकी त्रिज्याओं के वर्गों का योग 100 है, तो d का मान क्या है?
eh:
प्रयुक्त सूत्र
प्रत्यक्ष उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा (L):
L² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² ---(i)
अनुप्रस्थ उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा (M):
M² = d² - (r₁ + r₂)² ---(ii)
समीकरण (i) और (ii) को जोड़ने पर:
L² + M² = d² - (r₁ - r₂)² + d² - (r₁ + r₂)²
= 2d² - [r₁² - 2r₁r₂ + r₂² + r₁² + 2r₁r₂ + r₂²]
= 2d² - 2(r₁² + r₂²)
दिया गया है: L² + M² = 200, r₁² + r₂² = 100
200 = 2d² - 2×100
d² = 200
d = √200 = 10√2

t: In triangle ABC, the length of side BC is 2 cm less than twice the length of side AB. The length of side AC exceeds the length of side AB by 10 cm. The perimeter of the triangle is 40 cm. Determine the length (in cm) of the smallest side of the triangle.
e:
Let the length of side AB = x cm
Then, length of side BC = 2x - 2 cm
And, length of side AC = x + 10 cm
Perimeter of triangle ABC = AB + BC + AC
Given perimeter = 40 cm
So, x + (2x - 2) + (x + 10) = 40
=> x + 2x - 2 + x + 10 = 40
=> 4x + 8 = 40
=> 4x = 40 - 8
=> 4x = 32
=> x = 8
Therefore, the length of the smallest side (AB) = 8 cm

t: A circle is inscribed in a right-angled triangle with legs of length 5 and 12. What is the area of the quadrilateral formed by the two legs and the two radii to the tangent points on the legs?
e: Using Pythagoras theorem; Hypotenuse²=Perpendicular²+Base² =12²+5²=13² Hypotenuse = 13units Inradius = (Perpendicular+Base-Hypotenuse)/2 = (5+12-13)/2=2 units. k = 1

t: In a triangle ABC, AB = 33 cm, AC = 56 cm, and BC = 65 cm. From vertex A, a median AD is drawn that meets BC at point D. If G is the point on AD that denotes centroid, then find the length of AG.

t: If x²-1, 2x and x²+1 are the three sides of a right angled triangle, then find which of the following can be its hypotenuse?
e:
x²+1,x²-1,2x

x²+1>x²-1 for all value of x

Now, take x²+1 as hypotenuse

(x²+1)²=(x²-1)²+(2x)²

x⁴+1+2x²=x⁴+1-2x²+4x²

x⁴+1+2x²=x⁴+1+2x²

L.H.S = R.H.S

Thus, from above we can conclude 'x²+1" can be the hypotenuse.

→ When we take 2x as hypotenuse, LHS≠ RHS.
h: यदि x²-1, 2x और x²+1 एक समकोण त्रिभुज की तीन भुजाएँ हैं, तो ज्ञात कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा इसकी कर्ण हो सकता है?
eh:
x²+1, x²-1, 2x


x के सभी मानों के लिए x²+1 > x²-1 होता है।


अब, x²+1 को कर्ण (hypotenuse) मान लीजिए।


(x²+1)² = (x²-1)² + (2x)²


x⁴ + 1 + 2x² = x⁴ + 1 - 2x² + 4x²


x⁴ + 1 + 2x² = x⁴ + 1 + 2x²


L.H.S = R.H.S


अतः, उपरोक्त से हम यह निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं कि 'x²+1' कर्ण हो सकता है।


→ जब हम 2x को कर्ण मानते हैं, तो LHS ≠ RHS होता है।

t: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral. If angle P is three times the angle R and angle S is five times the angle Q, then the sum of the angles Q and R is:

h: PQRS एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज है। यदि कोण P, कोण R का तीन गुना है और कोण S, कोण Q का पाँच गुना है, तो कोण Q और R का योग है:
eh: चक्रीय चतुर्भुज के सम्मुख कोणों का योग = 180 ̊ ∠P + ∠R = 3x + x = 180 ̊ ∠P + ∠R = 3x + x = 180 ̊ = x = 45 ̊ ∠S + ∠Q = 5y + y = 180 ̊ = y = 30 ̊ ∠Q +∠R = x + y = 45 ̊ + 30 ̊ =75 ̊

eh: केंद्रक माध्यिका को 2 : 1 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है। AE = 24 cm इसलिए, AO = 2/3 × 24 = 16 cm OE = 1/3 × 24 = 8 cm ∆COE में, क्षेत्रफल = ½ × OC × OE × sinθ = 1/2 × 12 × 8 × 1/√2 = 48/√2 = 144√2 cm

t: What is the length (in cm) of chord PQ in a circle with a radius of 7 cm, where a diameter AB and a non-diameter chord PQ intersect perpendicularly at point C, and the ratio of AC to BC is 4 : 3?
e: 4x + 3x = 14 ⇒ x = 2 AC = 8cm BC = 6cm In △ OPC (OP)² = (OC)² + (PC)² (7)² = (1)² + (PC)² PC = √(48) = 4√(3) Length of chord PQ = 2 × PC = 2 × 4√(3) = 8√(3)

t: The area of the sector of a circle is 128 sq. cm. If the length of the arc of that sector is 64 cm, then find the radius of the circle.
e:
Let the radius of the circle be 'r' cm.
Since, the area of the sector = 128 cm<sup>2</sup>
And the length of the arc of that sector = 64 Cm
So,
r/2 * 64 = 128
r = 4 cm
h: एक वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल 128 sq. cm. है। यदि उस त्रिज्यखंड के चाप की लंबाई 64 cm है, तो वृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t:
Find the value of k, if the following pair of linear equations have infinite solutions?
kx + 7y - k = 5 and 6x + (5k - 1)y = 16
e:
kx + 7y - k = 5
=> kx + 7y = (k + 5)
and 6x + (5k - 1)y = 16
For infinite solutions =>
k/6 = 7/(5k - 1) = (k + 5)/16
Now,
16k = 6(k + 5)
16k = 6k + 30
k = 3
h:
k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए, यदि रैखिक समीकरणों के निम्नलिखित युग्म के अनंत हल हैं?
kx + 7y - k = 5 और 6x + (5k - 1)y = 16

t: In a ∆MNO, ∠NOM = 45°, ∠OMN = 120° and side ON = 18√6 cm, then the length of side MN of ∆MNO is equal to:
e: Given, ∠NOM = 45°, and ∠OMN = 120°, and side ON = 18√6 cm By sine rule, ON/sin120° = MN/sin45° => 18√6/(√3/2) = MN/(1/√2) => MN = 36√2 * 1/√2 => MN = 36 cm
h: एक ∆MNO में, ∠NOM = 45°, ∠OMN = 120° और भुजा ON = 18√6 cm है, तो ∆MNO की भुजा MN की लंबाई किसके बराबर है?

t: In a Δ PQR, PQ = 8 cm and QR = 18 cm. How many possible whole values PR can take?
e:
PQ = 8 cm, and QR = 18 cm
Sum of PQ and QR = 26 cm
Difference between PQ and QR = 10 cm
So, 10 < PR < 26
Hence, PR can take (26 - 10 - 1 =) 15 whole values.
h: एक Δ PQR में PQ = 8 cm और QR = 18 cm है। PR कितने संभावित पूर्ण मान ले सकता है?

t: In the given figure, PQ, QS and ST are three tangents to the circle. If QS = 28 cm and ST = 3PQ/4, then find the sum of length of RS and ST.
e: QS = 28 cm and ST = 3PQ/4 and PQ = QR and RS = ST QR + SR = 28 So, PQ + ST = 28 PQ + 3PQ/4 = 28 PQ = 16 cm ST = 16*3/4 = 12 cm ∵ RS + ST = 12 + 12 = 24 cm
h: दी गई आकृति में, PQ, QS और ST वृत्त की तीन स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं। यदि QS = 28 cm और ST = 3PQ/4 है, तो RS और ST की लंबाई का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: In a right angled triangle PQR which is right angles at Q, S is the bisector of ∠P such that ∠PSR = 117˚ and S lies on QR, then what is the measure of ∠R?
e: According to the question: Here, ∠PSR = 117˚ Then, ∠PSQ = 180 - 117 = 63˚ Now, ∠QPS = ∠SPR = 180 - 90 - 63 = 27˚ Therefore, ∠R = 180 - 2 * 27 - 90 = 36˚
h: एक समकोण त्रिभुज PQR में, जो Q पर समकोण है, S, ∠P का समद्विभाजक इस तरह से है कि ∠PSR = 117˚ है और S, QR पर स्थित है, तो ∠R का माप कितना है?

t: What is the length of the base of the parallelogram whose corresponding altitude is thrice the base and the area of the parallelogram is 147 cm²?
e:
Let the base of the parallelogram be x cm.
∴ Height of the parallelogram = 3x cm.
Area of the parallelogram = x * 3x
=> 3x² = 147
=> x² = 49
=> x = 7 cm
h: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज जिसकी संबंधित ऊंचाई, आधार के तीन गुना है और समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल 147 सेमी² है, तो समांतर चतुर्भुज के आधार की लम्बाई कितनी है?

t: In a circle with centre O, PQR is a tangent at point Q on the circle. AB is a chord in the circle parallel to the tangent such that angle ∠ BQR = 70°. What is the measure of ∠ AQB?
e: ∠ BQR = ∠ QAB (by alternate segment theorem) ∠ ABQ = ∠ RQB = 70° [alternate angle] In △ AQB ∠ AQB + ∠ QBA + ∠ BAQ = 180° ∠ AQB = 180° - 70° - 70° = 40°
h: केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त में, PQR वृत्त पर स्थित बिंदु Q पर स्पर्श रेखा है। AB वृत्त में स्पर्श रेखा के समानांतर एक जीवा है, जिसमें कोण ∠ BQR = 70° बनता है। ∠ AQB का मान क्या है?

t: In the following figure, PQ is parallel to TV and RU is parallel to QW. If ∠RUV = 48° and ∠WUT = 67°, then what is ∠QWU equal to?
e: ∠RUW = 180° - 67° - 48° = 65° Since, RU || QW and WU is transversal line So, ∠QWU + ∠WUR = 180° (co- interior angle) =>∠QWU + 65° = 180° =>∠QWU = 115°

t: Consider the following figure, P and Q are the centres of circles. If AB = 8√3 cm, and PQ = r cm, then find the value of PM.
e: AM = AB/2 = 4√3. In Δ PAM, PA2 = AM2 + PM2 r2 = (4√3)2 + (r/2)2 [PA = PQ = radius] r2 = 48 + r2/4 3r2/4 = 48 r2 = 64 r = 8 cm Hence, PM = 8/2 = 4 cm

t: An isosceles △ MNP is inscribed in a circle. If MN = MP = 16√(5) cm, and NP = 32 cm what is the radius (in cm) of the circle?
e: NP = 32 cm NQ = QP = 16 cm MN = MP = 16√(5) cm By pythagoras theorem MQ = 32 cm R = (abc/4△) = (16√(5) × 16√(5) × 32/4 × (1/2) × 32 × 32) R = 20 cm

t: In a circle of radius 3 cm, two chords of length 2 cm and 3 cm lie on the same side of a diameter. What is the perpendicular distance between the two chords?
e: In Δ OAM, OM2 = 9 - (3/2)2 OM2 = 27/4 OM = 3√3/2 cm In Δ OCN, ON2 = 9 - 1 = 8 ON = 2√2 cm MN = ON - OM MN = 2√2 - (3√3/2) cm MN = (4√2 - 3√3)/2 cm

t: Two lines intersect, forming four angles. One of the angles measures 5x-10 degrees and its adjacent angle measures 3x+30 degrees. What is the measure of the angle vertically opposite to the 5x-10 degree angle?
e:
Two adjacent angles are supplementary.
5x – 10 + 3x + 30 = 180<sup>0</sup>
8x=160°
x = 20°
Vertically opposite angles are equal
= 5x – 10 = 5 × 20 – 10 = 90°
h: दो रेखाएँ एक-दूसरे को काटती हैं, जिससे चार कोण बनते हैं। इनमें से एक कोण का माप 5x-10 डिग्री है और उसके आसन्न कोण का माप 3x+30 डिग्री है। 5x-10 डिग्री वाले कोण के ठीक सामने (शीर्षाभिमुख) स्थित कोण का माप क्या होगा?

t: Two lines PQ and RS are parallel; A and B are two points on the line PQ and O is any point on the line RS. If ∠PAO = 74° and ∠QBO = 134°, then find the measure of ∠AOB.
e: ∠PAO = 74° ∠QBO = 134° ∠AOS = ∠PAO = 74° ∠BOR = ∠QBO = 134° ∠BOS = 180° - ∠BOR = 180° - 134° = 46° ∠AOS = ∠AOB + ∠BOS 74° = ∠AOB + 46° ∠AOB = 28°
h: दो रेखाएं PQ और RS समानांतर हैं; दो बिंदु A और B रेखा PQ पर है और O रेखा RS पर कोई बिंदु है | यदि ∠PAO = 74° और ∠QBO = 134° है, तो ∠AOB का माप ज्ञात करें|

e: 2 × × r = 88 r =14 OC = 14 + 6 = 20 OD = OC + 1 =21 CD2 = OC2 + OD2 = 202 + 212 = 400 + 441 CD = 29 Half of CD = 1/2 × 29 =14.5cm 12

t: Δ WYX is a right-angled triangle, right angle at Y. YZ is perpendicular to XW such that XZ = 2.4 cm, and ZW = 6.5 cm. The length (in cm) of XY lies between:
e: Since YZ is perpendicular to WX. So, YX2 = XZ * XW XY2 = 2.4 * 8.9 XY = √21.36 XY = 4.6 (approx.) So, the value of XY lies between 4 and 6 cm.

t: ΔXYZ and ΔPQR are similar. XY : PQ = 6 : 1. Area of ΔPQR is 6 cm<sup>2</sup>. What is the area of ΔXYZ?
e:
XY : PQ = 6 : 1
Area of ΔPQR = 6 cm<sup>2</sup>
Since, ΔXYZ and ΔPQR are similar =>
Area(ΔXYZ) / Area(ΔPQR) = (XY/PQ)<sup>2</sup>
Area of ΔXYZ = (6/1)<sup>2</sup> * 6 = 216 cm<sup>2</sup>
h: ΔXYZ और ΔPQR समान हैं। XY : PQ = 6 : 1. ΔPQR का क्षेत्रफल 6 सेमी है। ΔXYZ का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?

t: In triangle ABC, medians AD,BE, and CF intersect at the centroid G. What is the ratio of the area of triangle GAB to the area of triangle ABC?
e: Three medians from each vertex divides triangle into 6 equal areas, when they intersect at Centroid. Area ∆GAB: area ∆ABC 2 : 6 (units) 1 : 3
h: त्रिभुज ABC में, माध्यिकाएँ AD, BE और CF केंद्रक G पर प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं। त्रिभुज GAB के क्षेत्रफल का त्रिभुज ABC के क्षेत्रफल से अनुपात क्या है?
eh: त्रिभुज के प्रत्येक शीर्ष से खींची गई तीन माध्यिकाएँ, जब केंद्रक पर एक-दूसरे को काटती हैं, तो त्रिभुज को 6 बराबर क्षेत्रों में विभाजित कर देती हैं। क्षेत्रफल ∆GAB : क्षेत्रफल ∆ABC 2 : 6 (इकाइयाँ) 1 : 3

t: A triangle PQR, angle P=50°, Q=60°, and side PQ=10cm. Find the angle between sides PR and QR?
e: given: ∠P=50° ∠Q=60° ∠P+∠LR=180° (sum of angles of triangle is 180°) ∠R= 180°-(50°+60°) ∠R=70° this is the angle that lies between PR and QR.
h: एक त्रिभुज PQR है, जिसमें कोण P = 50°, Q = 60° और भुजा PQ = 10 cm है। भुजाओं PR और QR के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
eh: दिया गया है: ∠P=50° ∠Q=60° ∠P+∠LR=180° (ट्रायंगल के एंगल का जोड़ 180° है) ∠R= 180°-(50°+60°) ∠R=70° यह वह एंगल है जो PR और QR के बीच है।

t: ABCD is a trapezium in which AB is parallel to CD, and E and F are the mid-points of non-parallel sides AD and BC. If EF is parallel to AB, AB = 28 cm and CD = 18 cm, then find EF (in cm).
e:

t: AB is a circle with centre O, AB is a diameter. Points C, D and E are on the circle on one side of AB such that ABEDC is a pentagon. What is the sum of angles ACD and DEB?
e: Let ∠ ACD and ∠ DEB are α and β ACDE is cyclic quadrilateral ∠ ACD + ∠ DEA = 180° α + ∠ DEA = 180° ∠ ACD + ∠ DEB = 90° + 180° - α + α = 270°

eh: ठीक तीन स्पर्श रेखाओं का मतलब है कि वृत्त एक-दूसरे को केवल स्पर्श करते हैं। केंद्रों के बीच न्यूनतम दूरी = r₁ + r₂ = (5 + 3) cm = 8 cm

t: Two right-angled triangular blocks, ABC and DEF have ∠B=∠E=90<sup>0</sup>. If the lengths of the hypotenuses AC and DF are equal, and the sides AB and DE are equal, are the triangles congruent? If so, by what rule?
e: AC = DF (Hypotenuse) ∠B = ∠E (Both 90°) AB = DE (lr sides are equal) Then by RHS rule, both are congruent.
h: दो समकोण त्रिभुजाकार ब्लॉक ABC और DEF हैं, जिनमें ∠B = ∠E = 90° है। यदि कर्ण AC और DF की लंबाई बराबर है, और भुजाएँ AB और DE बराबर हैं, तो क्या ये त्रिभुज सर्वांगसम हैं? यदि हाँ, तो किस नियम के अनुसार?
eh: AC = DF (कर्ण) ∠B = ∠E (दोनों 90°) AB = DE (अन्य भुजाएँ बराबर हैं) अतः RHS नियम के अनुसार, दोनों सर्वांगसम हैं।

t: In a triangle ABC, side BC is extended to a point D. The exterior angle at C is 112°. The interior angles at A and B are in the ratio 3 : 4. What is the measure of the largest interior angle of the triangle?
e: 3x + 4x = 112°. 7x = 112° ⇒ x = 16°. Angles of △ABC are 48°, 64°, 68°. Largest angle of the triangle = 68°.
h: त्रिभुज ABC में, भुजा BC को बिंदु D तक बढ़ाया गया है। C पर बाह्य कोण 112° है। A और B के आंतरिक कोणों का अनुपात 3 : 4 है। त्रिभुज के सबसे बड़े आंतरिक कोण का मान क्या है?

t: Two circles with centres M and N have radii 5 cm and 8 cm, respectively. The circles touch each other externally at point T. A line PR is drawn such that the points M, T and N lie on PR, P being closer to M. From P, a tangent PQ = 12 cm is drawn to the circle with centre M touching at Q. and from R, another tangent RS = 15 cm is drawn to the circle with centre N touching at S. What is the length [in cm] of PR?
e: PM = 13 by Pythagoras RN =17 by Pythagoras PR = PM + MN + NR =13 + 5 + 8 + 17 = 43
h: M और N केंद्र वाले दो वृत्तों की त्रिज्याएँ क्रमशः 5 सेमी और 8 सेमी हैं। वृत्त एक दूसरे को बिंदु T पर बाह्य रूप से स्पर्श करते हैं। एक रेखा PR इस प्रकार खींची गई है कि बिंदु M, T और N, PR पर स्थित हैं, P, M के करीब है। P से, केंद्र M वाले वृत्त पर एक स्पर्श रेखा PQ = 12 सेमी खींची गई है जो Q पर स्पर्श करती है। और R से, केंद्र N वाले वृत्त पर एक और स्पर्श रेखा RS = 15 सेमी खींची गई है जो S पर स्पर्श करती है। PR की लंबाई [सेमी में] क्या है?
eh: पाइथागोरस के अनुसार PM = 13 पाइथागोरस के अनुसार RN = 17 PR = PM + MN + NR =13 + 5 + 8 + 17 = 43

e: In a right-angle triangle: Inradius [r] = 3 cm Circumradius [R] = 12.5 cm Now, R = H = 2R = 2 × 12.5 = 25 cm Also, r = P + B - 25 = 2r = 6 P + B = 31 In a right-angle triangle: P² + B² = H² = [25]² [P + B]² - 2PB = 25² 31² - 25² = 2PB PB = ×[31 + 25] × [31 – 25] × P × B = × 56 × 6 Area of triangle = 84 cm² 2nd method {short trick}: Area = r² + 2rR = 3² + 2 × 3 × 12.5 = 9 + 75 = 84 cm²
